item.title: Sheriff warns of texting scam
item.description: MARQUETTE, Mich. (WAMQ) – The Marquette County Sheriff’s Department is warning people of a new scam that is transmitted via text messaging. The scammers send recipients an official-looking, but fake, court document demanding payment for unpaid tolls.
